name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps focus on the data, matching Manus’s competitive analysis where dark themes improve readability for dense visuals. The trade-off is that some users in bright environments may prefer light mode upfront, but a quick toggle fixes that without cluttering the interface.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode by default still risks users missing errors in glare—like Manus’s dashboard. The real risk is inconsistent error visibility across modes. Settle it with A/B testing: measure error detection rates in both modes under controlled lighting.
